title: End-to-end tracing
body: Follow a request from the first prompt through every tool call, retrieval and model response, with latency and cost on each span.

title: Evals in CI
body: Run golden datasets on every pull request and block merges when quality regresses, just like unit tests.

title: Cost controls
body: See spend per feature, per customer and per model. Set budgets that alert before the invoice does.

title: Guardrails
body: Detect PII, prompt injection and policy violations in real time, with redaction before data leaves your VPC.

title: Session replay
body: Replay any conversation with the exact prompts, context and model version that produced it.

title: Two-line SDK
body: OpenTelemetry-native SDKs for TypeScript and Python. Instrument once, export anywhere.
